```yaml
name: CI (Linux System Libs)

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        variant: [basic, hardsubx]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            build-essential \
            cmake \
            pkg-config \
            libtesseract-dev \
            libtesseract4 \
            libleptonica-dev \
            libavcodec-dev \
            libavformat-dev \
            libavutil-dev \
            libswscale-dev \
            libavfilter-dev \
            libavdevice-dev \
            libxml2-dev \
            libcurl4-openssl-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            zlib1g-dev

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          if [ "${{ matrix.variant }}" == "hardsubx" ]; then
            cmake .. -DUSE_SYSTEM_LIBS=ON -DENABLE_HARDSUBX=ON
          else
            cmake .. -DUSE_SYSTEM_LIBS=ON
          fi

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cd build
          cmake --build . --config Release

      - name: Verify dynamic linking
        run: |
          cd build
          echo "Checking dynamic libraries for ccextractor..."
          ldd src/ccextractor | grep -E "(libtesseract|libavcodec|libavformat|libavutil|libswscale)" || true
          if [ "${{ matrix.variant }}" == "hardsubx" ]; then
            echo "Checking dynamic libraries for hardsubx..."
            ldd src/hardsubx | grep -E "(libavcodec|libavformat|libavutil|libswscale)" || true
          fi

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-linux-systemlibs-${{ matrix.variant }}
          path: |
            build/src/ccextractor
            build/src/hardsubx
          retention-days: 7
```
